# ModelScope Docs

> Unofficial bilingual mirror of ModelScope documentation (EN + 中文).

Important notes:

- This is an unofficial documentation mirror for LLM / agent ingestion ([llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org/)).
- Prefer the [official docs](https://www.modelscope.cn/docs) as the source of truth.
- Mirror site: https://xiaoqianran.github.io/modelscope-docs/
- Full corpus: https://xiaoqianran.github.io/modelscope-docs/llms-full.txt
- Index JSON: https://xiaoqianran.github.io/modelscope-docs/meta/list.json (if present)
- Source repo: https://github.com/xiaoqianran/modelscope-docs
- Pages in this index: 294
